decision.observation: It is Saturday the 6th at 6:20 a.m.; the farmer is in bed with full energy, and money has fallen to 329g after another late night.
decision.hypothesis: Leaving immediately provides a full day to reach Willy by taking Pelican Town's southern east–west road east across the river, then turning south toward the beach.
decision.memory: Repeated late nights reduce money. Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, use the mailbox-level path east. At the paved junction west of town, take the southeast branch to the fountain; continue south to the east–west town road, then go east—do not take town's south exit into the wooded river area.
